Bom.base.text:
﻿# a leading comment
summaries:
  customAverage: 'values.mean().round(3)'
  plainSummary: values.sum()
properties:
  status:
    displayName: Status
    unknownPropKey: kept
  formula.ppu:
    displayName: Price per unit
  file.ext:
    displayName: Extension
  note.unused: {}
formulas:
  ppu: "(density / silica).toFixed(2)"
  spaced: 'type + " "  + file.name'
  hashish: '"#" + status'
  colonish: 'if(status == "a", "x: y", "z")'
  bracketish: '[1, 2, 3].join(", ")'
  longOne: 'if(status == "todo", "a rather long string that exists only to see whether the emitter folds a line at eighty columns", "no")'
  trailingSpace: 'status + "x" '
filters:
  and:
    - 'status != "done"'
    - file.hasTag("rock")   # a comment after a filter
    - or:
        - 'density > 1'
        - not:
            - 'silica < 50'
views:
  - type: table
    name: My table
    # a comment inside a view
    order: [file.name, status, formula.ppu]
    sort:
      - property: status
        direction: DESC
    groupBy: {property: status, direction: ASC}
    limit: 10
    summaries:
      formula.ppu: Average
    unknownViewKey: kept
    nestedUnknown:
        deep:
            - 1
            - a
  - type: cards
    name: Cards
    order:
        - file.name
        - formula.ppu
newItemFolder: Notes
newItemTemplate: Templates/Rock.md
unknownTopKey:
  nested: 1
